note: Every hash field in this file is deliberately empty. Hashes are filled and frozen before execution, never invented in advance. validate_round8_config.py --check refuses to report the config as executable while any required hash is empty.

prohibited: any synthetic candidate as an initialization
allowed_processing: deterministic trim, pad and window extraction
fixed numeric scaling the runtime requires

amendment.change: E002 moved from sealed to validation
amendment.reason: Only two human speakers were ever recorded for the sealed set. The Owner reassigned E002 from the sealed final holdout to validation so a real held-out voice exists for threshold, candidate and epoch selection. E006 and E007 remain the sealed final-qualification set, pending future recordings.
amendment.immutability_note: splits stays immutable:true. This amendment was not a silent data edit: the same move had to be made in the hard-coded round8_config.SPLITS constant, whose check() refuses any round8_config.json whose splits disagree with it. Bumping this version records that a reviewed code change, not a config-only edit, made the move.

E002.reason: only two human speakers available; Owner reassigned E002 from sealed evaluation to validation

manifests.note: Reassigned from sealed evaluation to validation by Owner decision (see splits.amendment / splits.consumed). Now a held-out voice for threshold, candidate and epoch selection, and no longer the sealed final holdout. A validation build needs a manifest declaring the 'validation' split; its round-6/7 frozen manifest declares 'eval_sealed' and must be re-derived/re-frozen for validation before it can be built. Its near set lacks 'okay youtab', 'hey google' and bare 'hey', and its 'hey you tab' takes carry a pause inside the name.

recorded_negative_corpora.name: speech_commands_v0.02.tar.gz
recorded_negative_corpora.role: real negatives only, never a positive speaker
recorded_negative_corpora.partitioned_by: the corpus's own validation_list.txt and testing_list.txt, then a speaker-id hash bucket

recorded_negative_corpora.name: mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0 (en)
recorded_negative_corpora.blocked_on: one Owner action: accept the gated dataset terms while signed in, and export a read-scope HF token
recorded_negative_corpora.role: real negatives only, never a positive speaker
recorded_negative_corpora.why: the only pool with the hours to demonstrate the 0.2/h target at all

background_recordings.total_real_seconds_note: sum of the rounded per-file durations; the unrounded sum measures 279.4 s
background_recordings.correction_applied: VALIDATION_NOISE in build_dataset.py named pink_noise.wav, which is generated. It is now ('doing_the_dishes.wav',), and build_dataset.GENERATED_BACKGROUND_NAMES drops both generated files before any split is cut, counting the drop in stats.generated_background_excluded. That is the same named-and-counted exclusion build_human_dataset.GENERATED_BACKGROUND_NAMES applies to its recorded_background sources. round8_config.check reads all three constants out of the builder, so the correction cannot be reverted silently.
background_recordings.what_the_correction_cost: Validation and train each held two background recordings, one of them generated. Each now holds one real recording. No real seconds were lost - the four real recordings and their 279.4 s were always the whole real pool - but validation's background evidence is one room, 95.2 s, 47 windows, which is what dataset_projection.validation and validation_gate target 4 already assume.

window_construction.offsets_derivation: integer-frame enumeration of build_dataset.PHRASE_END_JITTER (0.16-0.64 s of trailing context) at the runtime's 80 ms frame rate; derived, not tuned

dataset_projection.note: Projected from the recording package's take list. Recomputed from the frozen manifests before execution; the projection is recorded so a discrepancy is visible.
dataset_projection.retired_because: all four were synthesized from TTS voices

architecture.family: three Conv1d layers over the frame axis, then a small dense head
architecture.normalization: per-embedding-dimension mean/std, folded into the first convolution at export

variation.kind: exactly three predeclared widths; a closed set, not a range, not a minimum and not a maximum
variation.why_exact: A range would let a pre-run config edit add a fourth width or drop one without an Owner decision, which is the stop condition being widened by the file it constrains. round8_config.check refuses any arm count but three, and names the stop condition when it does.
sweeps_forbidden: class weights beyond the one derived rule
variation.stop_condition: If no arm meets all five targets on E005 validation, stop and report the measured capacity-accuracy relation. Do not add a fourth width, do not widen the set, do not begin any other variation without an explicit Owner decision.
variation.why: It is the one hyperparameter the 113x collapse of the positive class leaves undefined, and the only direction R5 never measured. R5 measured capacity up as harmful: 6.31x parameters, 6.4x false rejects at each candidate's own selected threshold.

initialization.resume_allowed: only from this round's own crash checkpoint; each arm's output directory must be empty at launch
initialization.why_a_new_seed: 20260807 belonged to the synthetic era; the draw order is entirely different, and reusing the seed would imply draw-for-draw comparability that does not exist

loss.focal_form: per * (1 - p_t) ** gamma, p_t = pred for positives and 1 - pred for negatives
loss.derivation_rule: Choose w so the positive class's share of total loss mass equals r6c1's measured 8.953%, with negative_weight = w and hard_negative_weight = 2w, preserving r6c1's exact 6:3 hard-to-ordinary ratio. Recomputed from the frozen manifest counts before the first epoch.
loss.rejected_alternative: cap the recorded negatives instead; matching r6c1's window ratio would use about 530 of 70577 permitted real negatives and would destroy the hours the 0.2/h target needs

schedule.epochs_deliberately_not_scaled: Restoring the step count would mean 284 passes over 1029 positive windows instead of 60. Sixty passes over three voices is already the memorisation risk.

utterance_aggregation.positive: a miss if none of its 7 windows fires
utterance_aggregation.near_phrase: a false accept if any of its 7 windows fires
utterance_aggregation.group_key: the source-utterance group id build_dataset already assigns

selection.threshold_rule: lowest threshold on E005 validation at which every false-accept target, tightened by validation_margin, is met; candidates are the observed negative scores themselves, so the search is exact
selection.epoch_rule: per epoch, the lowest threshold meeting the tightened targets and the utterance-level false-reject rate it buys; an epoch where no threshold satisfies the targets cannot be selected; lowest false-reject rate wins
selection.candidate_rule: lowest utterance-level false-reject rate on E005 at each arm's own validation-selected threshold

candidate_tie_break.why: 1.0 pt is below the 1.84 pt effect that 300 real windows bought, so inside the noise this pipeline has ever resolved; smaller is preferred because memorising three training speakers is invisible on a single-speaker validation set

targets.name: ONNX/TFLite numerical and detection parity
targets.unit: detection disagreements, with latency and memory measured

export_and_parity.frame_score_delta: reported, not gated; r7 measured max 8.225e-06, mean 6.46e-08 over 31986 windows

validation_gate.rule: A candidate must pass 5/5 on E005 validation, on both backends independently, with zero detection-parity disagreements, BEFORE any sealed dataset is opened.
validation_gate.if_no_arm_passes: the sealed sets stay sealed and Round 8 reports a failure
validation_gate.reporting_rule: Targets 2, 3 and 4 are passed as 'not contradicted' on E005 and are never reported as demonstrated. Every figure is printed next to the bound its sample size supports.

statistical_power.method: rule of three (0 events in n trials bounds the rate at about 3/n at 95%) with exact Clopper-Pearson bounds; Poisson for per-hour rates
statistical_power.unit_of_evidence: utterance, never window; 7 deterministic framings of one utterance are one trial

target_1.shortfall: the programme can demonstrate '<=5% on a clean run' and cannot distinguish 5% from 9.7%; about 2x short of +-2.5 pts and 12x short of +-1 pt
target_1.speaker_level_caveat: 4-6 speakers is 4-6 draws from the population of voices; clustered on speaker the effective n for a claim about people is 2 sealed speakers plus E002, and no utterance count changes that

target_2.poisson_requirement: rate * hours >= 2.9957 for a clean run to bound the rate at 95%
target_2.correction_to_the_record: This target has never been demonstrated in any previous round either. The eval split's recorded-speech partition is 11.659 h, so a perfect clean run there bounds the rate at 0.257/h, above the 0.2/h target. Every 0.000/h in evidence/frontier.txt was one observed event away from 0.086/h.

target_3.remedy: a third sealed speaker recording the take list, or more takes of rows 6-13 from E006 and E007; an Owner decision about the recording programme

target_4.note: met or not met as a count; it is a claim about one or two rooms

target_5.requirement: compare every window of every category on both backends, including the full recorded-negative pool, because the real negative corpora are what keep n large once synthetic positives are gone

statistical_power.honest_summary: Targets 2 and 4 cannot be demonstrated by anything the recording programme will produce. Target 3 is 38 utterances short. Target 1 can be demonstrated on a clean run and cannot be estimated better than about +-5 points. Round 8 is worth running as the first measurement of a human-only model and for the capacity-accuracy relation on real data, not because 5/5 would prove the product is ready.

sealed_opening_rule.precondition: one arm has passed 5/5 on E005 validation, on both backends, with zero detection-parity disagreements
freeze_before_open: the validation-selected threshold at full float64 precision
every training manifest and its manifest_sha256
the common-voice lock and manifest if acquired
the runtime version and the repository commit SHA
sealed_opening_rule.measure: once, through the real ONNX and TFLite product runtimes, independently, at the frozen threshold
after: the threshold is not re-tuned on a sealed set
each sealed speaker is reported separately as well as pooled
a measured sealed set is spent and may not be reused for a different candidate

if_validation_fails.step_1: diagnose by real recording category using the validation manifest's own categories: close mic, varied rate and loudness, far field, real background noise; report confirmed-fire and peak-only rates for each so a plateau failure is distinguishable from a discrimination failure
if_validation_fails.step_2: exactly one evidence-backed structural correction, naming the measurement that motivates it, predeclared in a Round 9 design document before it is executed
if_validation_fails.step_3_forbidden: returning to synthetic data of any kind
if_validation_fails.step_3_precedent: R7 added 26000 clips from a genuinely disjoint TTS corpus and made false rejects 8.58 points worse, CI [7.66, 9.54]
also_forbidden: re-tuning the threshold on any sealed set
dropping a predeclared arm, which turns the capacity-accuracy relation into two points and a line through them
re-sweeping any hyperparameter this config holds fixed
reporting a window-level rate in place of an utterance-level one
if_validation_fails.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: r6c1, trained on 116000 synthetic positives and E001's own 300 real windows, confirms only 53.33% of E001's positives - a speaker it was fitted on. An arm trained on 147 utterances from three speakers and measured on an unseen fourth is unlikely to reach 5% false rejects, and targets 2 and 4 are undemonstrable regardless.

prerequisite_code_changes: a no-augmentation build path: Augmenter.apply (gain, synthesized RIR at REVERB_FRACTION 0.5, additive background at a drawn SNR in SNR_RANGE) is unconditional today and all three are prohibited; build_rir_pool synthesizes impulse responses with pyroomacoustics and must not run
POSITIVE_SPEECH_PREFIX_FRACTION set to 0: splicing an unrelated recorded word in front of the wake phrase manufactures an utterance that never happened, from two rooms and two speakers
the deterministic seven-offset window grid, replacing the random draw from PHRASE_END_JITTER, and deterministic non-overlapping tiling for non-anchored audio

generated background files excluded by name from every split, and VALIDATION_NOISE corrected - DONE: build_dataset.GENERATED_BACKGROUND_NAMES drops both before any split is cut, VALIDATION_NOISE is ('doing_the_dishes.wav',), and round8_config.check reads those constants out of the builder rather than trusting this list
utterance-level selection and reporting, aggregated on the source-utterance group id
a synthetic-input refusal guard: any TTS directory, any previous feature tensor, any r1-r7 checkpoint is a fatal error

r6_real_positives.claim: real human positives help, by 1.19x rather than the 2.4x on record
r6_real_positives.correction: the 2.4x on record is an artifact of the nine-point threshold grid: r4's grid steps from 0.60 (near-phrase FA 2.02%, which fails) straight to 0.70 (false rejects 23.14%), while r6c1 sat at 1.98% at exactly 0.60

r7_second_tts_family.claim: a second, genuinely disjoint TTS corpus made it worse

channel_gap.conclusion: the gap is the speech, not the channel

confirmation_rule_cost_points.conclusion: real utterances cross the threshold and fall back off it; the plateau is the binding defect

discrepancies_found_while_writing_this: SPEAKER_RECORDING_PACKAGE.md states '40 near x 4 speakers = 160'; the take list sums to 56 near-phrase utterances plus one conversation block per speaker. The document understates its own package.
The 23.14% -> 9.78% figure in ROUND7_DESIGN.md is a nine-point-grid artifact; the dense-grid effect is 11.66% -> 9.82%.
The 9.70% -> 10.16% R7 figures are not reproducible from the stored artifacts; R7 was materially worse than r6c1, not neutral.
The 0.2/h target has never been demonstrable on the eval split: 11.659 h bounds a clean run at 0.257/h.
